text: And it came to pass in the eleventh{H259} year,{H8141} in the third{H7992} [month], in the first{H259} [day] of the month,{H2320} that the word{H1697} of Jehovah{H3068} came unto me, saying,{H559}

to the end that none of all the trees{H6086} by the waters{H4325} exalt{H1361} themselves in their stature,{H6967} neither set{H5414} their top{H6788} among the thick boughs,{H5688} nor that their mighty ones{H352} stand up{H5975} on their height,{H1363} even all that drink{H8354} water:{H4325} for they are all delivered{H5414} unto death,{H4194} to the nether parts{H8482} of the earth,{H776} in the midst{H8432} of the children{H1121} of men,{H120} with them that go down{H3381} to the pit.{H953}
